name: Stephen J. Post
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Stephen J. Post serves on the West Hollywood Public Safety Commission and as a business improvement district manager for the Los Angeles Neighborhood Initiative. He has a master's degree in public administration from Ohio State University and advocated for criminal justice reforms at the Last Prisoner Project.

sentences.text: Stephen J. Post serves on the West Hollywood Public Safety Commission and as a business improvement district manager for the Los Angeles Neighborhood Initiative.
He has a master's degree in public administration from Ohio State University and advocated for criminal justice reforms at the Last Prisoner Project.

items.text: He opposes renewing the city's Flock Safety surveillance cameras contract. He supports Fountain Avenue safety improvements, including protected space for cyclists and accessible sidewalks. He supports exploring a commercial vacancy tax. He prioritizes preventing homelessness and expanding affordable housing, and supports capping rent increases. His campaign calls for participatory budgeting and building public housing. He proposes investing in green infrastructure, including stormwater capture and expanding the tree canopy, to prepare for climate emergencies.
